content: Khazing a rei tei Khri Zisu apostol a cangpaw kama Paul tah, Khri Zisu letei zingchuipaw Efesa khuapui mehpathai sahlo khatah ca ka ca kua he.
Kaa Paw Khazing le Abuipaw Zisu Khri taiteipaw ningdonah le thlawlungnah cawh naaning khatah ung ky seh.
Zisu Khri letei Thlawpaw bonghnang
Kaa Buipaw Zisu Khri a Paw le a Khazing, Khri Zisu letah Thlawpaw lang bonghnang maikaw khatei vaicung bonghnang a ma songtupaw cawh reithai tah ung ky seh.
Ama taco a mehmuh letah a pathaipaw le suise a kawh lypaw cang rua pawtah Khri letah khazaw tua hlai taitah kaaning cawh a ma thing.
Doná tah Khazing taco a dupaw le a lungtlingnah hratah Zisu Khri thongtah a sawtei leh cang rua pawtah khei a ma rawh pacia thah.
Macawtaco, a dopaw a Sawcapaw letah amai lytah a ma pehpaw, arungnawpaw a ningdonah rawng tahei Khazing cawh reithai he peh.
Khazing ningdonah a chang thai lypaw rawng takhei a thisai thongtah sua ngethainah le tlangnah cawh Khri letah kaa hmuh.
Ma ningdonah cawh singnah le hninah vytei khatah Khazing tah a ma luisopaw a cang.
Taico a lungtlingnah hratah Khri letei a tingpaw a dunah biaparuh khah kaaning cawh ma hnisah ka,
ma cawh a cai le a ning a va tling tihtah alui le avai letei a ungpaw hming vytei khah lu lukheh a cangpaw Khri a rai lekhei hmingkheh tah pahmo khah a cang.
Ama a khuakhangpaw le a za khykhi ciapaw hratah zezong a dunah le a tingpaw kha a tlahpaw teitah a tuatu taco Khri letah a ma thing.
Macawtaco Khri letah hnabeisuinah a hnui tawpaw kaaning sahlo tah Khazing rungnawnah cawh reithai he peh.

Taico naaning sahlo zong naaning pachahnah thawngchawbia hmuisui thui he ceh ka, naa zing ning taikhei Khri letah na ung hrah he ceh. A zing ciapaw naaning sahlo cawh Khazing tei na cang he ceh tah hninah tah biakangpaw Thlawpaw Pathai khei Ama leco cakhai tah nang na cang he ceh.
Thlawpaw Pathai cawh Khazing tah bia a ma kangpaw ry sahlo khah kaa cy a tah hninah amakhang a cang. Ma cawh Khazing tei a cangpaw sahlo tlangnah ning a tlingnah tai a rungnawnah reithainah a cang.
Alawngnah le thlawchangnah
Ma rawng tahei, Abuipaw Zisu letei na ngepainah he ceh le mehpathai vytei naa donah pawhe kong ka thui ning ri taikhei,
naa cawtah lawngbia hlai heh bang bei neh, ka thlawchangnah maikaw letah ka ca thui paria thlang he.
Kaa Buipaw Zisu Khri a Khazing, a rungnaw caipaw Paw tah ama naa hnipase khy nápawtah singnah Thlawpaw le hnipasenah cawh ca pei ky he seh tatah thlaw ka chang tei.

Naa lungthing meh a pasing khy nápaw caw zong tah thlaw ka chang, ma cawh a ca y hnohnangpaw he hnabeisuinah khah naa hni khy nápaw cawtah le mehpathai sahlo cy ruapaw ry a rungnaw zia naa hni khy nápaw cawtah a cang.

Taico Ama a zingpaw kaaning sahlo kaa caw tei zekhatahmai tah reipakhing khy lypaw a laisuipaw a hmingtuakhynah naa hni khy nápaw caw zong a cang. Ma hmingtuakhynah cawh alai ngeteipaw a thawtlungnah a rai hrenah khatah a lo ka,
Khri khah thihnah taitah patho kaw ka, vaicung raang letei a cacang lang letah a tysah ning tei a hmangpaw khah a cang.

Thlawpaw lang uhnah vytei le nawhnuinah sahlo le hmingtuakhynah le painah vytei le ming sahpaw vytei cung letah Ama cawh uhtu a cang. Ma cawh atocai caw long tahei cang lytah a va chuh lepaw cai caw zong tah a cang.
Taico Khazing tah zezongpui khah a pherai letah chia ka, khrisawbu cawtah zezongpui letah lu cangpaw tah a chia.
Khrisawbu cawh Ama a pung, Ama a tlangtlingnah cang ka, Ama tah zezongpui khah kawkih letah a chisah.
